mutations.name: a run in sh-cleanup reads as watching main CI again
mutations.find:
({ run, steps }) => heldWakeWait(run, steps),
  ({ run, phase }) => cleanupWait(run, phase),
kills: a run parked in recovery after it recorded its outcome says a running run past its main CI read is cleaning up, not watching main CI

mutations.name: every post-merge step reads as cleaning up
kills: a run parked in recovery after it recorded its outcome still says a run in sh-main-ci is watching main CI

mutations.name: a finished run left on sh-cleanup reads as still cleaning up
kills: a run parked in recovery after it recorded its outcome says none for a completed merged run whose last step was sh-cleanup

mutations.name: a running ci-wait with no read falls back to an older step's head
mutations.find: if (ciWaitRunning(run)) return ciWaitHead(run.currentStep, repo, pr) ?? null;
mutations.replace: if (ciWaitRunning(run)) return ciWaitHead(run.currentStep, repo, pr) ?? steps.map(headOf).filter((head) => head !== undefined).at(-1) ?? null;
kills: a run whose PR moved while its ci-wait runs (TP-4092) says the head is not yet read, never an older step's head, while the live ci-wait has read none (TP-4767)

mutations.name: a run that stopped at ci-wait reads as still waiting
mutations.find: const ciWaitRunning = (run: WorkflowRun): boolean => run.status === "running" && run.currentStep
kills: a run whose PR moved while its ci-wait runs (TP-4092) keeps the recorded head of a run that stopped at ci-wait
